# privateSLM

> privateSLM is a fully private AI chat app for iPhone, iPad and Mac. It runs
> entirely on-device: Apple Intelligence (Foundation Models framework) when
> available, or a downloaded open SLM (Llama, Qwen, Gemma) via llama.cpp.
> No cloud, no account, no tracking. One-time purchase.

## Apps
- privateSLM (App Store): https://apps.apple.com/app/id6504996891
- Circuit: Productivity AI (App Store): https://apps.apple.com/app/id6774522959
